details:
- Rebuild el9_6 against golang >= 1.25.7-1.el9_6.tuxcare.els16 to pick up the Go
  standard library fixes for:
- CVE-2026-33818: enforce a recursion limit in encoding/asn1 Unmarshal to
  prevent stack exhaustion on deeply nested input
- CVE-2026-56853: apply ReadHeaderTimeout while sniffing the unencrypted
  HTTP/2 client preface in net/http
- CVE-2026-56858: do not close an unescaped '/' early in html/template,
  preventing attacker-controlled content injection
- CVE-2026-56860: avoid quadratic complexity in net/url resolvePath by
  resolving '..' segments with index-based backtracking on a byte buffer
- CVE-2026-56862: stop counting handshake messages as state-advancing once the
  crypto/tls handshake has completed, bounding the key derivation work a client
  can force with repeated post-handshake KeyUpdate messages
